_comment: Two frames each: from the start ledge, which is where the player is
asked to read the route, and from inside it.
CAMERA FRAME (L-52): every `eye` is the manifest anchor with x and z
negated, because the runner yaws the MODEL and leaves the camera in

key_energy is down to 0.70 and ambient up to 0.24. The bench rig is built for a subject on a backdrop, where the key clears the model; a shaft with no ceiling lets it hit one wall square-on, and the first pass rendered the right-hand wall pure white (L-56).

The _start cameras stand 1.4 m onto a 4 m ledge, not at its lip: at the engine's 90 deg fov the bottom of the frame is only 1.6 m ahead, so a camera on the edge renders the ledge it is standing on as empty void.

shots.name: P_ascent_start
shots.caption: ASCENT - 5 PLATFORMS, EACH A FULL 1.00 M HIGHER
shots.note: MAX_VERTICAL_STEP DROPS THE REACH TO 2.00 M. BUILT AT 1.80

shots.name: P_ascent_mid
shots.caption: ON THE THIRD PLATFORM, TWO TO GO
shots.note: THE WALL STUB IS THE FLOOR THAT USED TO BE HERE

shots.name: P_stagger_start
shots.caption: STAGGER - 6 PLATFORMS, ALTERNATING 1.6 M EITHER SIDE
shots.note: MEASURED JUMP 2.31 M AGAINST A 2.40 M BOUND AT STEP 0.50

shots.name: P_stagger_mid
shots.caption: MID-ROUTE, LOOKING AT THE NEXT DIAGONAL
shots.note: EVERY JUMP TURNS YOU. NO TWO ARE THE SAME ANGLE

shots.name: P_spans_start
shots.caption: SPANS - 3 BEAMS, FLAT, VERTICAL_STEP 0.00
shots.note: A CROSSING, NOT A CLIMB. THE FAR LEDGE IS VISIBLE FROM HERE

shots.name: P_spans_back
shots.caption: FROM THE END LEDGE, WHERE THE ENEMIES WAIT
shots.note: PLATFORM_PATH() SPAWNS ON THIS LEDGE, NEVER ON THE ROUTE

shots.name: P_ascent_over
shots.caption: THE WHOLE CLIMB, FROM ABOVE THE START
shots.note: 5 SEGMENTS, 31.3 M END TO END, EXITING 5.0 M UP

shots.name: P_stagger_over
shots.caption: THE WHOLE ROUTE, FROM ABOVE THE START
shots.note: THE ALTERNATION IS THE DESIGN. IT ONLY READS FROM HERE

shots.name: P_spans_over
shots.caption: THE WHOLE CROSSING, FROM ABOVE THE START
shots.note: 3 BEAMS, FLAT, 25.1 M. NOTHING IS CLIMBED
